verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents a log streaming service that exports tenant logs in near real-time to a log analysis service, with configurable content type and format and a payload preview in the Dashboard. That covers the stream-to-SIEM half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows the logs are tamper-evident or explicitly confirms they cover both authentication and admin activity. missing for 10: evidence of tamper-evident or integrity-protected logs, explicit coverage of authentication and admin/management events, named SIEM destinations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
